title: Ukubwa wa Nomino (Theme 11: Mapato)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child turns an m- noun with a one-syllable root into its big form with ji- (mti -> jiti) and gives it LI-YA agreement.
representations: a small and a huge drawing of the same thing
steps: Is the root one syllable? Add ji-.
contexts: a giant in a folk tale
a huge tree in the forest

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mti mkubwa sana huitwa ___." Kwa nini "kijiti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ukubwa wa nomino hutumia ji-: jiti, jito, jiji. Udogo hutumia ki-: kijiti, kijito, kijiji.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mji mkubwa sana huitwa ___." Kwa nini "mji" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kuonyesha ukubwa, nomino yenyewe hubadilika: mji-jiji.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Miti mikubwa sana huitwa ___." Kwa nini "jiti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa ukubwa hutumia ma-: majiti, majito, majiji, majitu.
Nomino ya ukubwa huchukua upatanisho wa LI-YA: jitu linakuja.
